packs.title: SRD 5.2 — System Reference Document
packs.summary: The free D&D rules: classes, species, backgrounds, feats, spells, items and more.
packs.description:
The System Reference Document 5.2.1 is the part of the 2024 D&D rules that Wizards of the Coast publishes for free, under Creative Commons.

It has every class with one subclass each, the core species and backgrounds, origin and general feats, hundreds of spells, and the equipment and magic items to go with them. Fieldbook's character building, spells and inventory all work from it.
